sparql: SELECT ?authorName WHERE { ?author <https://schema.org/name> ?authorName . ?publication <https://schema.org/author> ?author . ?publication <https://schema.org/author> ?coauthor . FILTER (?author != ?coauthor) } GROUP BY ?author ?authorName ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(DISTINCT ?coauthor)) LIMIT 1

question: Who has published the most about 'GOVERNMENT'?
englishQuestion: Who has published the most about 'GOVERNMENT'?
sparql: SELECT ?authorName WHERE { ?author <https://schema.org/name> ?authorName . ?publication <https://schema.org/author> ?author . { ?publication <https://schema.org/about> ?topic . ?topic <https://schema.org/name> ?topicName . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?topicName), LCASE("GOVERNMENT"))) } UNION { ?publication <https://schema.org/keywords> ?keyword . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?keyword), LCASE("GOVERNMENT"))) } UNION { ?publication <https://schema.org/name> ?title . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), LCASE("GOVERNMENT"))) } } GROUP BY ?author ?authorName ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?publication)) LIMIT 1
